players.product: NovaLT and Frame 5 gas turbines plus Brush generators for behind-the-meter data-center power (Chart Industries thermal management added July 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference presentation (September 9, 2026) updates Baker Hughes FY'26 guidance to include Chart from its 07/16/2026 acquisition closing: BKR revenue $28,500M-$30,300M (midpoint $29,400M) and adjusted EBITDA $4,875M-$5,475M (midpoint $5,175M); Chart revenue $1,850M-$2,250M and EBITDA $300M-$400M. OFSE and IET outlooks are unchanged. Chart assumptions: FY'26 results weighted to the fourth quarter, RPO of ~$3.6B expected at the end of 3Q'26 after alignment to Baker Hughes accounting policies, and book-to-bill above 1x expected in 2H'26.
